tasks.script_en: Hi, Anna. Our English class is not at nine today. It starts at ten thirty in room twelve.
tasks.question_en: When does the English class start?
tasks.explanation_ru: Говорящий исправляет первое время: занятие начинается at ten thirty, то есть в 10:30.

tasks.script_en: I need milk, bread, and two apples. I will go to the grocery store after work and then cook dinner.
tasks.question_en: What is the speaker mainly talking about?
options: Buying food
Going to a restaurant
Starting a new job
Making breakfast
tasks.explanation_ru: Главная мысль — покупка продуктов: перечислены milk, bread, apples и поход в grocery store.

tasks.script_en: Every morning I take a shower, eat some eggs, and walk to the bus stop. I drink coffee at the office.
tasks.question_en: What does the speaker do after breakfast?
options: Takes a shower
Walks to the bus stop
Drinks coffee at home
Goes back to bed
tasks.explanation_ru: После eat some eggs идёт walk to the bus stop; кофе человек пьёт уже в офисе.

tasks.script_en: I want to get my laptop, but the office is dark and the front door is locked. It is seven o'clock on Sunday morning.
tasks.question_en: Why can't the speaker get in?
options: The office is closed on Sunday
There is no electricity in the building
The front door is broken
It is too late in the evening
tasks.explanation_ru: Человек пришёл за ноутбуком, но дверь заперта (locked), внутри темно, а на часах seven o'clock on Sunday morning — в выходной офис закрыт. Дверь не сломана, а заперта; темно, потому что внутри никого нет, об электричестве ничего не сказано; и сейчас утро, а не вечер.

tasks.script_en: This coffee smells great, but it is much too sweet for me. Next time I will order it without sugar.
tasks.question_en: How does the speaker feel about the coffee?
options: Likes everything and will order the same again
Likes the smell, but not the taste
Likes the taste, but not the smell
Does not like it and will not order it again
tasks.explanation_ru: Запах говорящий хвалит (smells great), а вкус нет: кофе much too sweet. Отказываться от него он не собирается — в следующий раз закажет without sugar.

tasks.script_en: Attention, please. The train to Boston will leave at eleven fifteen from platform six, not platform four. It is running ten minutes late.
tasks.question_en: Which platform will the train leave from?
options: Platform four
Platform five
Platform six
Platform ten
tasks.explanation_ru: Объявление специально противопоставляет from platform six, not platform four.

tasks.script_en: I usually work at the office, but today I am staying home. A repair person is coming to fix my kitchen sink, so I will join all meetings online.
tasks.question_en: What is the speaker mainly telling the team?
options: The speaker is sick and cannot come to today's meetings
The speaker is staying home today but will join the meetings
A repair person is coming to fix the kitchen in the office
Today's meetings are moving online for the whole team
tasks.explanation_ru: Главное сообщение: сегодня человек работает из дома (today I am staying home), но на всех встречах будет онлайн (I will join all meetings online). Мастер придёт к нему домой чинить раковину, а онлайн встречи только для него, а не для всей команды.

tasks.script_en: First, check that all the tests are green. Then ask Maria to review the change. After she approves it, you can deploy the new version.
tasks.question_en: What should happen immediately before deployment?
options: Checking that the tests are green
Getting Maria's approval
Asking Maria to review the change
Asking Maria to deploy
tasks.explanation_ru: Порядок такой: tests are green → ask Maria to review → she approves → deploy. Непосредственно перед deploy стоит её одобрение; просьба о ревью идёт раньше, а выкатывает версию сам слушатель, а не Maria.

tasks.script_en: Leo's chair is empty, and he sent me a photo from the airport this morning. He said he would be back in the office next Monday.
tasks.question_en: Why is Leo's chair empty?
options: He is on a trip
He is in another meeting
He is having lunch
He is sick at home
tasks.explanation_ru: Фото из аэропорта и возвращение в офис только в следующий понедельник указывают на поездку, а не на встречу, обед или болезнь.

tasks.script_en: The new app looks cleaner, and the search is faster. I still cannot find the settings easily, but overall this update is much better than the old version.
tasks.question_en: What is the speaker's overall opinion?
options: Mostly positive
Completely negative
Not interested
The old and new versions are identical
tasks.explanation_ru: Есть один минус со settings, но overall и much better показывают в целом положительную оценку.

tasks.script_en: We originally promised the report by Thursday afternoon. Since the finance team cannot send its figures until Thursday evening, I have agreed with the client to deliver the final version before noon on Friday.
tasks.question_en: What is the new deadline for the final report?
options: Thursday morning
Thursday afternoon
Thursday evening
Friday before noon
tasks.explanation_ru: Старый срок был Thursday afternoon, а согласованный новый — before noon on Friday.

tasks.script_en: Yesterday's outage was not caused by the new release. One of our database certificates had expired, so the service could not connect after its scheduled restart. We renewed the certificate and added an automatic warning for next time.
tasks.question_en: What is the main purpose of this message?
options: To report that yesterday's outage was caused by the new release
To explain the real cause of the outage and its fix
To announce a scheduled restart of the database service
To warn the team that more certificates will expire soon
tasks.explanation_ru: Сообщение объясняет настоящую причину outage — истёк сертификат базы, — сделанное исправление и новое предупреждение на будущее. Новый релиз прямо назван невиновным, а restart упомянут как момент сбоя, а не как анонс.

tasks.script_en: Please write down the two changes the customer requested and send the notes to the team. Once everyone has checked them, create the tickets, but do not estimate the work until tomorrow's planning meeting.
tasks.question_en: What should the listener do after the team checks the notes?
options: Create the tickets
Estimate the work
Call the customer again
Start coding immediately
tasks.explanation_ru: После проверки заметок нужно create the tickets; оценивать работу просят только на завтрашнем planning.

tasks.script_en: Sam did not say much during the first ten minutes, but his answers became detailed when we discussed real production problems. He also asked thoughtful questions about monitoring and support duties.
tasks.question_en: What can be inferred about Sam?
options: He has little experience with production systems
He became more comfortable as the interview went on
He knows monitoring better than coding
He is more interested in support than in development
tasks.explanation_ru: Сначала Sam говорил мало, а потом стал подробно отвечать о реальных production problems и задавать продуманные вопросы — он освоился. Monitoring и support он лишь упомянул в своих вопросах; сравнения с кодом или разработкой в записи нет.

tasks.script_en: I understand why we added a second approval, and it has already caught two serious mistakes. However, waiting a full day for every small documentation change feels unnecessary. I think we should keep the rule only for code changes.
tasks.question_en: What does the speaker think about the new process?
options: It is useful but should cover only documentation changes
It is useful but applied too broadly
It slows everyone down and has caught nothing serious
It is fine as it is, but reviews should be faster
tasks.explanation_ru: Второй approval уже поймал две серьёзные ошибки, но ждать сутки ради мелкой правки документации говорящий считает лишним и предлагает оставить правило только для code changes — то есть сузить его, а не ускорить.

tasks.script_en: Our cloud bill rose by eighteen percent in the first quarter, mainly because the analytics cluster was running overnight. Turning it off outside business hours should save about twelve thousand dollars a month, while the planned storage change will save another three thousand.
tasks.question_en: How much should the storage change save each month?
options: Three thousand dollars
Twelve thousand dollars
Fifteen thousand dollars
Eighteen thousand dollars
tasks.explanation_ru: Twelve thousand относится к отключению кластера, а storage change даст another three thousand.

tasks.script_en: Moving every customer at once would shorten the project, but a single unnoticed compatibility issue could affect the entire platform. We will therefore start with internal accounts, monitor them for two weeks, and expand the migration only if the error rate remains stable.
tasks.question_en: Which approach has the team chosen?
options: Moving every customer at once to finish sooner
Starting with internal accounts and expanding if errors stay stable
Migrating only internal accounts and stopping there
Moving all customers at once, then monitoring for two weeks
tasks.explanation_ru: Одновременный переезд сократил бы проект, но рискован, поэтому команда начнёт с internal accounts, понаблюдает две недели и расширит миграцию, только если error rate останется стабильным. Две недели наблюдения относятся к внутренним аккаунтам, а не ко всем клиентам.

tasks.script_en: Before you leave, update the incident guide and walk Nina through the unresolved payment issue. She will take over the support rotation once she has access to the dashboard, so ask security to grant that access before arranging the handover call.
tasks.question_en: What must happen before the handover call is arranged?
options: The payment issue must be resolved
Nina must receive dashboard access
The support rotation must end
The incident guide must be deleted
tasks.explanation_ru: Прямо сказано grant that access before arranging the handover call.

tasks.script_en: Marketing has already prepared the announcement, and the feature passed all functional tests. Still, the team lead asked everyone to keep Friday evening free and requested an additional rollback rehearsal on Thursday.
tasks.question_en: What is the team lead probably concerned about?
options: Marketing announcing the feature too early
Problems in production after the launch
The feature failing its functional tests
The announcement not being ready in time
tasks.explanation_ru: Функциональные тесты пройдены и анонс готов, но тимлид просит держать свободным вечер пятницы и ещё раз отрепетировать rollback — он опасается проблем в эксплуатации после запуска. О спешке маркетинга в записи ничего нет.

tasks.script_en: The demo was polished, and I can see why the sales team liked it. Yet every difficult question was answered with a promise about the next release, while the contract requires a three-year commitment. I would not sign anything until we speak to existing customers.
tasks.question_en: How does the speaker feel about the vendor?
options: Impressed by the demo and ready to sign after the next release
Impressed by the demo but doubtful about the vendor's promises
Unimpressed by the demo but confident in the vendor's roadmap
Doubtful about the demo but happy with a three-year contract
tasks.explanation_ru: Демо говорящий хвалит (polished), но на каждый трудный вопрос звучало обещание про next release, а контракт требует трёх лет — поэтому он ничего не подпишет, пока не поговорит с existing customers. Ждать следующего релиза он не предлагает.

tasks.script_en: The shorter signup form increased completed registrations by nine percent, which looks encouraging at first glance. However, the improvement came almost entirely from mobile visitors. Desktop conversion remained unchanged, and the number of people who verified their email actually fell by two percent. We should keep the form but test a clearer verification screen before declaring the experiment successful.
tasks.question_en: Which metric became worse during the experiment?
options: Mobile registrations
Desktop conversion
Email verification
Completed registrations overall
tasks.explanation_ru: Общие регистрации выросли, desktop не изменился, а число подтвердивших email снизилось на 2 % (fell by two percent).

tasks.script_en: A separate service would give the reporting team independent releases and clearer ownership. It would also introduce another database, deployment pipeline, and on-call responsibility for a component that currently handles modest traffic. Rather than splitting it out now, I suggest defining a strict internal interface and measuring whether the existing module becomes a genuine bottleneck over the next quarter.
tasks.question_en: What is the speaker recommending?
options: Creating a separate service right away
Splitting it out next quarter, whatever the data shows
Keeping the module but giving it its own database
Keeping it for now and watching for a bottleneck
tasks.explanation_ru: Отдельный сервис дал бы независимые релизы, но добавил бы базу, pipeline и дежурства. Поэтому говорящий предлагает пока не выделять модуль: задать строгий интерфейс и в течение квартала измерять, станет ли он настоящим bottleneck. Разделения через квартал он не обещает — всё решат измерения.

tasks.script_en: Confirm that the alert reflects customer impact rather than a monitoring fault. If it does, appoint an incident lead and open the shared timeline before paging the database team. Notify senior management only after the lead has published an initial impact estimate, unless legal or security concerns require immediate escalation.
tasks.question_en: Normally, what must happen before senior management is notified?
options: Legal or security approves the escalation
The lead publishes an impact estimate
The database team fixes the problem
The monitoring fault is repaired
tasks.explanation_ru: В обычном случае руководство уведомляют only after the lead has published an initial impact estimate. Legal и security — не согласование, а повод эскалировать сразу; ждать исправления проблемы не нужно, а monitoring fault — как раз случай, когда эскалации нет.

tasks.script_en: Dana normally challenges every estimate in the planning meeting, but today she accepted the six-week proposal without a single question. She had just come from a budget review, and afterward she asked me which features depend on the contractors' code and who else on the team could maintain it.
tasks.question_en: What is Dana probably expecting?
options: The project is about to get extra funding
The contractors may soon leave the project
The contractors' code will have to be rewritten
The team will soon hire more full-time engineers
tasks.explanation_ru: Dana пришла с budget review и спрашивает, какие функции держатся на коде подрядчиков и кто ещё в команде сможет его поддерживать, — она готовится к тому, что contractors уйдут. О новых деньгах, найме или переписывании кода в записи ничего нет.

tasks.script_en: I appreciate the attempt to make collaboration more deliberate, and two shared office days could help new employees build relationships. What worries me is the blanket requirement for everyone, regardless of role, location, or team performance. A policy with explicit exceptions and a review after three months would be far easier to support.
tasks.question_en: Which description best matches the speaker's position?
options: Supports the rule but wants more office days
Supports the goal but objects to one rule for everyone
Supports the goal but wants the rule for new hires only
Accepts the rule but doubts it will help collaboration
tasks.explanation_ru: Цель (more deliberate collaboration) и два общих дня говорящий принимает, но возражает против blanket requirement for everyone и просит явные исключения и пересмотр через три месяца. Новичков он упоминает как тех, кому общие дни помогут, а не как единственных, для кого нужно правило.

tasks.script_en: The headline forecast puts annual growth at seven percent, but that figure assumes the enterprise contract closes in September and is recognized immediately. Under the finance team's more conservative scenario, where revenue is spread across the contract term, reported growth would be closer to four and a half percent. Neither estimate includes a possible acquisition, despite recent speculation in the press.
tasks.question_en: Why could the seven percent headline figure be misleading?
options: It counts all the contract's revenue at once
It already includes the possible acquisition
It assumes the contract will not close until next year
It is based on the finance team's cautious method
tasks.explanation_ru: Seven percent предполагает, что enterprise contract закроют в сентябре и выручку признают сразу (recognized immediately). Консервативный сценарий финансистов распределяет её по сроку контракта и даёт около 4,5 %, а возможная покупка компании не входит ни в один прогноз.

tasks.script_en: Allowing each team to choose its own tools has encouraged experimentation, but it has also left the company maintaining five deployment systems and training engineers repeatedly on local conventions. A central platform must not become a gatekeeper that freezes good ideas. Its mandate should be to provide a well-supported default and transparent extension points, while requiring exceptions to carry their own operational costs.
tasks.question_en: What is the speaker's main proposal?
options: Let the central platform approve new tools before any team adopts them
Keep a supported default, but let teams opt out at their own cost
Keep full team choice, with the platform paying to run every exception
Move every team to one deployment system with a single set of conventions
tasks.explanation_ru: Говорящий предлагает поддерживаемый default с extension points; исключения допустимы, но сами несут свои эксплуатационные расходы. Роль привратника он прямо отвергает (must not become a gatekeeper), а переводить всех на одну систему не требует.

tasks.script_en: Do not lead with the discount, because that would make price the only reference point. First establish which service guarantees the client genuinely values, then quantify what meeting them costs us. Once the client acknowledges that trade-off, offer the longer contract in exchange for the lower rate. Leave the termination clause until last, after the commercial terms are provisionally settled.
tasks.question_en: When should the lower rate be offered?
options: At the very start
After the client accepts the service-cost trade-off
Only after the termination clause is signed
Before discussing service guarantees
tasks.explanation_ru: Сначала ценность гарантий и их стоимость, затем признание trade-off, и только после этого lower rate за длинный контракт.

tasks.script_en: The board praised the proposal's ambition and asked the team to refine the implementation timeline. At the same time, it postponed the funding decision, requested a scenario requiring half the initial capital, and added the chief risk officer to every future review. No one rejected the strategy outright, but the next presentation has been reduced from an hour to twenty minutes.
tasks.question_en: What can most reasonably be inferred about the board?
options: It is ready to fund the plan once the timeline is refined
It is interested but not ready to commit the full budget
It thinks the proposal is not ambitious enough
It wants a longer, more detailed presentation next time
tasks.explanation_ru: Интерес есть: совет похвалил ambition, просит уточнить timeline, и стратегию никто не отверг. Но решение о деньгах отложено (postponed the funding decision), нужен сценарий с половиной initial capital, а в каждый review добавлен chief risk officer — всю сумму совет давать пока не готов. Амбициозность он как раз хвалит, а следующую презентацию не удлинил, а сократил с часа до двадцати минут.

tasks.script_en: Leadership describes the reorganization as a way to eliminate duplication, which is a legitimate concern. Yet the published chart moves decision-making upward while leaving delivery targets untouched, and the consultation period begins only after the new roles have been announced. Calling that empowerment stretches the word beyond recognition. I would support consolidation if authority moved closer to the teams actually carrying the risk.
tasks.question_en: What is the speaker's attitude toward the reorganization?
options: Accepts the aim but objects to decisions moving upward
Welcomes the new roles but wishes consultation had started earlier
Doubts that duplication exists but likes the new chart
Accepts the new chart but wants lower delivery targets
tasks.explanation_ru: Цель убрать duplication говорящий называет legitimate concern, но критикует то, что решения уходят наверх (moves decision-making upward), и поддержит консолидацию, только если authority moved closer to the teams. Позднюю consultation он приводит как ещё один симптом, а новые роли и схему не одобряет.
